title: Tell stale marks from fresh ones
breadcrumb: Tell stale marks from fresh ones

slides.title: Read the label
slides.html: The second line of a label gives the mark's age, Local when it is not known to be in a feed, and who made it. A stale mark's label turns grey and reads Stale.

slides.title: Stale in the Inbox
slides.html: A stale report leaves Near you, 1 km for Older reports (1) at the end of the Inbox. Its row under Received turns grey.

slides.title: Open older reports
slides.html: Tap Older reports (1). The report opens in its place, greyed, with the day and time it was seen, here 21.11. 0413.

slides.title: Admins set the time
slides.html: Admins tap ≡, scroll the tools to OpenDefence Main, tap it and scroll to Server configuration (admins). Under Enemy marks go stale after they pick from 6 h to 7 d, 24 h unless changed, then tap Publish… at the end of the pane.
